vendor/hap is ewilken/hap-rs v0.1.0-pre.15 (commit b13bf31).
Changes from upstream:
- Swap get_if_addrs for if-addrs, so the crate links the system ifaddrs
  library once. See src/config.rs get_local_ip.
- Every service sends its linked services to Home ("linked"), when it has
  any. Upstream left them out, so Home could not group linked services.
- Read the whole request body. Upstream parsed only its first chunk, so a
  request split across frames, like Home's event subscriptions for a TV,
  failed with 500 and Home reconnected without end.
- The switch service carries Configured Name, which Home labels it by.
- Clear the Rust warnings the crate raises.
